count_notes.classes: playable races excluding undead and drakes: humans 52, dunefolk 31, elves 22, dwarves 18, merfolk 16, orcs 12, nagas 11, saurians 10, goblins 7, trolls 7, ogres 2. Boats 20 and fake 1 not counted.

creature_families.note: beasts, insects, sea, spirits, dragons; HP 13 to 142
four ladders: ghoul line, walking corpse to soulless, skeleton lines, spirit lines; plus human necromancer tree
fire line, fighter line, clasher line, sky line, Armageddon (L4, no advance)
one growth ladder with ambush and regenerates_8 at every stage, plus a shaman (L2)

top_creatures.label: breath-and-bite great drake
top_creatures.why: three attacks on one 101 HP body: ranged fire breath (4 x 14, marksman) plus melee bite and tail; rest idle with uneven frame timing
top_creatures.keep: split melee and ranged attacks on one unit; uneven rest-idle timing
top_creatures.change: breath is a cone over a line of tiles; battle-cry instead of leadership

top_creatures.label: hatchling clutch
top_creatures.why: 0-move egg with 32 HP that acts by proximity: hatches when an enemy starts its turn adjacent, or when a neighbour egg breaks
top_creatures.keep: eggs act by rule, not by timer; neighbour chain
top_creatures.change: visible countdown on the tile before hatch; cap of 3 eggs

top_creatures.label: bone wyrm
top_creatures.why: level 4 undead dragon, 98 HP; only the jaw carries drains (15 x 3), claws 27 x 2 plain
top_creatures.keep: drain on one attack only, so the bite reads clearly
top_creatures.change: drain becomes a bone-mark that wears off after a few turns

top_creatures.label: ink-and-tentacle deep horror
top_creatures.why: tentacle 10 x 5 with swarm (strike count falls with HP); ink ranged 3 x 8 with poison
top_creatures.keep: swarm: strikes scale with HP fraction
top_creatures.change: ink leaves a lingering cloud on tiles instead of a status

top_creatures.label: ambush leaper
top_creatures.why: level 3, 72 HP; hidden until adjacent (ambush); fangs 3 x 10 with drains
top_creatures.keep: hidden until adjacent; drain on fangs
top_creatures.change: leap from a ledge with a telegraph frame so it reads at 375 px

top_creatures.label: sapling-to-ancient growth ladder
top_creatures.why: four stages, one per level, all with the same ambush and regenerates_8 pair; the unit grows, it does not change identity
top_creatures.keep: one growth ladder with a fixed ability set
top_creatures.change: stage read by silhouette height and bark colour, not a new name per stage
top_creatures.ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/wesnoth-wesnoth/data/core/units/wose/Wose_Sapling.cfg line 17; also Wose.cfg, Elder.cfg, Ancient.cfg line 17

top_creatures.label: burrowing beetle
top_creatures.why: level 1, 36 HP, burrow ability; cheap early unit that hides in the ground
top_creatures.keep: burrow as a hidden state on an early unit
top_creatures.change: burrowing shows a dust burst and rumble, then emerges from the same tile

top_creatures.label: frost-fist giant
top_creatures.why: level 4, 142 HP, largest HP in monsters/; fist 2 x 32 impact (values read from file, not receipted)
top_creatures.keep: single big impact body the player must step around
top_creatures.change: fist slam leaves a frost patch on tiles around the target

looks.label: recruit fade-in

originals.name: Clutch Nest

originals.change: visible countdown on the tile; cap of 3 eggs

originals.name: Breath Wyrm
originals.idea: level 5 drake with a melee pair and a ranged breath, with a breathing idle
originals.keep: melee and ranged split on one unit
originals.change: breath is a cone; battle-cry replaces leadership

originals.name: Swarm Horror
originals.idea: sea unit whose strike count falls as HP falls
originals.change: ink becomes a lingering zone tile, not a status

originals.name: Growing Thicket
originals.idea: four-stage plant ladder with one fixed ability set
originals.keep: one ability set across the ladder
originals.change: stage shown by silhouette height, no new name per stage

originals.name: Bone Mark
originals.idea: undead drain on one attack only
originals.change: drain becomes a mark that wears off in a few turns

originals.name: Lit Grove
originals.idea: glowing mushroom terrain used as a light source
originals.change: light helps both sides; no alignment split

originals.name: Storm Pickup
originals.idea: race-locked pickup that adds a ranged attack

originals.change: attack chains to a second target

originals.name: Ambush Leap
originals.idea: hidden predator that strikes from cover
originals.change: visible leap telegraph for readability at 375 px
